# Pivota

> Pivota is the commerce decision and execution layer for AI agents. Its Commerce Index helps agents decide what to recommend, resolve product and offer paths, route transactions through merchant-controlled systems, and keep execution state connected to existing storefront, payment, fulfillment, and operations stacks.

For complete route discovery, see [sitemap.xml](https://pivota.cc/sitemap.xml).

## Primary pages

- [Homepage](https://pivota.cc/): Pivota, the commerce decision and execution layer for AI agents.
- [Product / category page](https://pivota.cc/merchant-gateway-for-agent-native-commerce): What the commerce decision and execution layer does: Commerce Index, checkout routing and write-back over existing merchant systems.
- [Agent integration](https://pivota.cc/agent-integration): REST, MCP, authentication, webhooks, and execution flows for agent builders; the pivota-agent PyPI package is not maintained, so use REST.
- [Merchant onboarding](https://pivota.cc/merchant-onboarding): Practical onboarding paths for merchants connecting agent demand to existing systems.
- [AI readiness](https://pivota.cc/ai-readiness): Readiness check for catalog, offer, checkout, payment, and write-back blockers.
- [How Pivota works](https://pivota.cc/how-pivota-works): Execution model from demand to discovery, checkout, payment, and measurement.
- [FAQ](https://pivota.cc/faq): Plain answers about Pivota, merchant-native checkout, rollout paths, and integrations.
- [About](https://pivota.cc/about): Company positioning and what Pivota is building.
- [Blog](https://pivota.cc/blog): Pivota writing on agentic commerce and merchant-controlled execution.

## Developer documentation

- [Verify Pivota](https://pivota.cc/developers/verify): A three-lane verification path covering commerce index, decision layer and checkout routing, with the expected result for each call. The four public read-only tools at https://mcp.pivota.cc/mcp — search_catalog, get_product, get_alternatives and get_intel — require no credentials. Lane 2 also includes recommend_products, which requires an API key on the authenticated native endpoint at https://commerce.mcp.pivota.cc/mcp and is absent from the UCP dialect. Checkout routing requires scoped access, buyer identity and merchant readiness; a ready session or payment link is not proof of payment.
- [Developer overview](https://pivota.cc/agent-integration): Developer entry point for Pivota's agent integration surface.
- [First call](https://pivota.cc/developers/first-call): First authenticated API call and first order path.
- [Request types](https://pivota.cc/developers/request-types): Search, recommendation, cart, checkout, order, status, event, webhook, and payment-aware request families.
- [Authentication and webhooks](https://pivota.cc/developers/auth-webhooks): API keys, webhook signature verification, webhook delivery, and lifecycle signals.
- [Protocols](https://pivota.cc/developers/protocols): Current protocol support status (see below).
- [API overview](https://pivota.cc/developers/request-types): Public API overview for agent builders.

## Protocol support (as of 8 October 2026)

Pivota does not author any of these standards.

- MCP (Model Context Protocol): live. Four public read-only research tools at https://mcp.pivota.cc/mcp (search_catalog, get_product, get_alternatives, get_intel); a keyed endpoint at https://commerce.mcp.pivota.cc/mcp adds scoped capabilities such as recommend_products.
- UCP (Universal Commerce Protocol): seller door live for discovery and catalog search (profile at https://commerce.mcp.pivota.cc/.well-known/ucp, vendor capability cc.pivota.insights). Checkout through the UCP door is limited and needs OAuth buyer identity and merchant readiness.
- ACP (Agentic Commerce Protocol): internal beta; not self-serve.
- AP2 (Agent Payments Protocol): internal beta; not self-serve.
- Visa Intelligent Commerce, Visa Trusted Agent Protocol, Mastercard Agent Pay: not supported.

## Educational pages

- [What is agent-native commerce?](https://pivota.cc/what-is-agent-native-commerce): Definition of the merchant-controlled path from agent demand to catalog, checkout, payment, and post-purchase systems.
- [What is agentic commerce?](https://pivota.cc/what-is-agentic-commerce): Market context for LLM- and agent-shaped commerce.
- [Make products discoverable to AI shopping agents](https://pivota.cc/make-products-discoverable-to-ai-shopping-agents): How merchants improve product, variant, and offer resolution for agents.
- [Do I need to rebuild my store?](https://pivota.cc/do-i-need-to-rebuild-my-store): Why Pivota layers on top of existing storefront and operations systems.
- [Start before merchant-native checkout](https://pivota.cc/start-before-merchant-native-checkout): Discovery, feeds, and link-out paths before deeper checkout execution.
- [Merchant-native checkout](https://pivota.cc/merchant-native-checkout): Checkout paths that keep merchant systems and payment relationships in control.
- [Promotion readiness](https://pivota.cc/promotion-readiness): Offer and incentive readiness for executable agent demand.
- [Pivota implementation effort](https://pivota.cc/pivota-implementation-effort): Rollout stages and integration effort.
- [Pivota vs Shopify](https://pivota.cc/pivota-vs-shopify): How Pivota works with store platforms instead of replacing them.
- [Skincare and beauty merchants](https://pivota.cc/skincare-beauty-merchants): Agent-readiness patterns for beauty and skincare merchants.
- [Use cases](https://pivota.cc/use-cases): Illustrative merchant scenarios across discoverability, checkout, payment, and measurement.

## Press and announcements

- [Press](https://pivota.cc/press): Dated announcements about Pivota with links to primary sources, and facts for describing Pivota. Founder and CEO: Peng Xu. Pivota does not hold customer funds and is not the merchant of record.
- 8 October 2026 — [Animoca Brands' AIR and Minds partner with Reap and Pivota to enable identity-powered personalized agentic commerce](https://www.animocabrands.com/announcement/animoca-brands-air-and-minds-partner-with-reap-and-pivota-to-enable-identity-powered-personalized-agentic-commerce) (Animoca Brands press release; also the [AIR blog](https://air3.com/blog/air-minds-reap-pivota-agentic-commerce)). In the proposed architecture, Pivota will provide the merchant decision and order execution layer. Status: announced; a controlled demonstration with a single merchant integration is planned, and no transaction results have been published.

## Case studies

- [AIR, Minds, Reap and Pivota: an identity-powered agentic commerce pilot](https://pivota.cc/case-studies/air-minds-reap-pilot): who does what in the proposed architecture (AIR identity credentials, Minds agents, Reap scoped payment credentials, Pivota product/merchant/transaction path, merchant remains merchant of record), the proposed transaction lifecycle, and current status.
